function.name: _wb_create_user_schedule
function.description: Create a team scheduled task (UserSchedule / t_user_schedule). Note: this is a team-side scheduled task that periodically sends a prompt to Informatclaw/AI by cron; it is not an application designer scheduled task ScheduleDefine and must not be used to create an in-app schedule module.

name.description: User scheduled task name, for example: Daily sales summary.

cron.description: Cron expression, for example daily at 09:00: 0 0 9 * * ?. Confirm the frequency before creation and avoid overly frequent schedules.

prompt.description: Prompt sent to Informatclaw/AI when the schedule runs. Include the task goal, data scope, output format, and necessary constraints.

schedulePeriod.description: Optional period type. Leave empty when unclear; the backend calculates nextRunTime from cron.

expertId.description: Optional expert ID. Fill only when the user explicitly wants a specific expert to execute the task.

retryCount.description: Optional retry count after failure, recommended 0-10.

isEnable.description: Whether the schedule is enabled. Defaults to true.

misfireThreshold.description: Optional misfire threshold, interpreted by backend UserSchedule configuration.

key.description: Optional business key for the user schedule. Do not fill when unsure.

serverIdList.description: Optional list of server IDs allowed to execute the task. Do not fill when unsure.
